# Principles

- Keep pull requests small enough to review on a phone. (source: owner-stated, 2025-11-01)
- Write one acceptance criterion per observable behaviour. (source: example, 2025-12-01)
- Name the exact test command in every plan's task-group checks. (source: example/project docs/retros/I-20251210-1-example.md, 2026-01-04)
